memory: Certainly! To proceed with signing up for the BrewPerks program, please visit our website and navigate to the membership page. There, you can select the membership tier that best suits your preferences and complete the registration process. Once you've signed up, you'll receive a confirmation email with details about your membership benefits and how to access the member portal. If you have any further questions or need assistance along the way, feel free to reach out. Thank you for your interest in the program, and we look forward to welcoming you as a valued member!
